profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Stay Ai
profile.summary:
Strategic Software Engineer with a focus on architecting scalable, high-performance web applications. Advanced in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and the DOM API, with extensive experience building complex frontend systems and distributed Node.js microservices.

Having played a key role in scaling engineering organizations and products from inception to 80+ employees, I thrive in high-ownership environments where technical design meets business goals. I am passionate about mentoring engineers, refining technical standards, and delivering high-quality, user-centric software that solves complex operational challenges. 

Currently expanding my expertise through an M.Sc. in Software Engineering (AI Engineering) at Western Governors University, focusing on AI integration and advanced system architecture. 

Proficient: Typescript, Javascript, React, Node, Express, Nest.js,  MongoDB, Mongoose, mySQL, PostgreSQL, Git/Github/GitLab, HTML, CSS
Knowledgable: Python, JQuery, Jest, Enzyme, OAuth, Mocha, Chai, Jasmine, Webpack, Babel

Always open to connecting and exploring new technologies!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · React · Node.js · PostgreSQL · JavaScript · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Event Driven Programming · NestJS

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Poochie
positions.description:
High-end Full Stack dog walking app
Project manager of a 6 person engineering team, implementing agile workflows
Lead designer of an auction functionality using React and Semantic UI, which allowed user to post a walk and a dog walker the chance to bid on it
Constructed navigation for entire application using React Router, which led to easy navigation for the user as well as easy code reuse for teammates

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer - Catwalk
positions.description:
Catwalk is an apparel e-commerce application needing a UI overhaul along with a more robust back-end to handle scalability

-Developed UX for related products and building custom outfit widget within the application
-Cleaned and imported existing data along with optimizing querying speeds for the applications API
-Introduced a click-tracking functionality into the application using React Higher-Order Components (HOC)
-Collaborated remotely using Agile workflow to design and deploy the overhauled application to an AWS(EC2) with service-oriented architecture

Tech Stack: JS, React, React-Hooks, Postgresql, Node/Express, Jest/Enzyme

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer - Catwalk
positions.description:
-Horizontally scaled microservice to handle 1200 requests per second with 10M records of product data, while maintaining an error rate <1% by deploying three Node.js/Express EC2 servers with AWS load balancer
-Reduced latency by 250% through indexing PostgreSQL database to optimize read operations
- Used Loader.io for deployed stress testing and Artillery for local stress testing

- Operational Leadership: Managed cross-functional teams of up to 12 in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment.
